title: Yeola Pure Silk Paithani Royal Peacock Saree
description: Known as the 'Queen of Sarees', woven from mulberry silk and fine gold zari using the interlocking weft technique to render the iconic Mor-Bangadi (peacock in bangle) pallu motif.

title: Authentic Warli Tarpa Tribal Folk Canvas Art
artisan: Warli Adivasi Vikas Sanstha (Jivya Soma Mashe Guild)
description: Ritualistic wall art created by Sahyadri indigenous tribes using chewed bamboo twigs, rice flour tempera, and cow-dung mud grounds celebrating harvest and the Tarpa spiral dance.

title: Authentic Kolhapuri Handcrafted Leather Chappals
description: Tanned with hard-myrobalan nuts and babul bark, hand-stitched exclusively using leather cords with no iron nails or synthetic adhesives.

title: Sawantwadi Lacquered Wooden Toy & Fruit Set
description: Carved from indigenous Pangara and Hale wood, polished with non-toxic lac lacquers derived from tree resins.

title: Sawantwadi Royal Dashavatara Ganjifa Playing Cards
description: Circular playing cards layered with cloth and tamarind glue, hand-painted with mineral tempera representing the ten avatars of Lord Vishnu.

title: Solapur Jacquard Diamond Weave Cotton Chaddar
description: Woven on jacquard looms using heavy-count combed cotton, producing signature geometric diamond relief weaves and floral end-borders.

title: Solapur High-Absorption Double-Loop Terry Towel
description: Engineered with double warp-loop structures for rapid moisture absorption and long-lasting softness.

title: Karvath Kati Vidarbha Tussar Silk Saree
description: Unbleached wild Kosa silk handwoven using a three-shuttle interlocking technique that creates the saw-tooth border along the temple edge.

title: Miraj Concert-Grade Tun Wood Tanpura
description: Crafted from hollowed Pandharpur river-gourds and seasoned red cedar with bone bridges, providing harmonic drone sustain for Hindustani ragas.

title: Miraj Master Hand-Engraved Classical Sitar
description: Featuring carved celluloid inlays on seasoned teak tabli, paired with hand-tuned frets for microtonal precision.

title: Hupari Heritage Seamless Silver Payal & Ghungroos
description: Crafted from 92.5% sterling silver using die-stamped hollow bead links and hand-burnished ghungroos without visible solder seams.

title: Puneri Silk Traditional Crimson Turban (Pagadi)
description: Historical Maharashtrian headdress structured over stiffened card-and-gond armature, wrapped in crimson silk and framed with zari border laces.

title: Pen Hand-Painted Eco-Shadu Clay Ganesh Idol
description: Hand-sculpted using biodegradable riverine Shadu clay and painted with water-soluble mineral pigments and natural lacquers.

title: Tuljapur Sacred Polished Kavdi Maal (Necklace)
description: Sacred devotional garland made of marine cowrie shells hand-sorted, smoothed, and knotted on colored cotton cords, worn as an emblem of faith by devotees of Goddess Bhavani.
